School funding in Iowa has not evolved as the 6 demographics of Iowa students have changed significantly, with 7 little attention paid to supporting the special education needs 8 of students. In order to meet the needs of such students and 9 to ensure access to special education across school districts, 10 the special education weighting work group shall review the 11 special education weighting plan under section 256B.9, which 12 has not been altered since 2004, and shall consider all of the 13 following: 14 a. How to increase special education weightings in a way 15 that both meets the needs of students and minimizes the need 16 for school districts to increase property taxes. 17 b. The standards associated with each special education 18 weighting. 19 c. Best practices in the United States related to funding 20 special education. 21 2. The school finance review committee met on December 22 16, 2024, and received a memo from the school budget review 23 committee that discussed how a review of special education 24 funding should be conducted. 25 3.
